title: Acquirer: Webster Limited; Target: Springs Seafood Pty Ltd

body_sections.Summary: On 22 July 2003, the Webster informed the Commission of its intention to acquire the business of Springs.
body_sections.Market definition: The national market for the wholesale supply of smoked salmon.
body_sections.Competition analysis: On 21 August 2003 the Commission decided that it would not intervene in the proposed aquisition.  The Commission made it decision on the basis of the following factors: the high level of imported product and likelihood of its pending increase; the availability of substitutes of smoked salmon; and the countervailing power held by large fish wholesalers and supermarkets.
